tagline: A leading global alternative investment manager with diversified fund strategies across credit, real assets, secondaries, and private equity
hero_kpi_rationale: AUM is the primary driver of recurring revenues and structural growth for Ares, directly reflecting its ability to raise funds and attract capital in the alternative investment sector.

kpis.explanation_en: Total value of assets the company manages on behalf of its clients.
kpis.signal: Robust 28% year-on-year growth, indicating strong demand and effective commercial execution.
kpis.description: AUM increased to $622.5 billion at the end of 2025 from $484.4 billion at the end of 2024, driven by new capital raises and positive fund valuations.

kpis.explanation_en: Portion of assets under management that generate management fees.
kpis.signal: Growth in line with AUM, indicating stable monetization of raised assets.
kpis.description: Represents assets from which the company directly collects management fees, calculated as total AUM minus non-fee-paying assets (622.5 - 23.7 = 598.8 billion $).

kpis.explanation_en: Weighted average rate of management fees applied to fee-paying assets under management.
kpis.signal: Implied weighted average rate based on core strategies, reflecting a diversified mix of funds and fee structures.
kpis.description: Estimated average rate derived from fee ranges disclosed in the 10-K (0.25% to 2.00% depending on strategies), reflecting a recurring and predictable revenue model.

kpis.explanation_en: Performance-related revenues earned when fund return targets are met.
kpis.signal: 83% year-on-year increase, reflecting strong portfolio gain realization.
kpis.description: Expected realized performance income of $75 million for Q1 2026 versus $41 million in the same period of 2025.

kpis.explanation_en: Number of employees in the company.
kpis.signal: Significant workforce for an alternative asset manager of this scale.
kpis.description: Estimated headcount based on company size and industry standards. Not explicitly provided in the 10-K.

kpis.signal: Total revenue of 4.756 Bn USD for the last fiscal year (FY2025).
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).

kpis.explanation_en: Net Income — bottom-line profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.signal: Net income of 0.527 Bn USD for the last fiscal year (FY2025).
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).

kpis.explanation_en: Total Assets — sum of all assets on the balance sheet.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 28.633 Bn USD for the last fiscal year (FY2025).
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).

Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.explanation_en: Share of net income paid out. >80% = potentially unsustainable.

ai_positioning.summary: Ares does not mention artificial intelligence in its 10-K/20-F filing.

risks.title: Contingent Repayment Obligations (Clawback)
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned in the 'Risks Related to Our Funds' section. The language indicates a potentially significant financial obligation for the company if certain conditions are triggered.

risks.title: Volatility of Performance Income
risks.score_rationale: The text details the nature of performance income (carried interest, incentive fees) and its dependence on fund performance. Volatility is inherent in this revenue stream and directly impacts profitability.

risks.title: Investment Valuation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The text describes realized and unrealized gains and losses on investments, which depend on changes in fair value. Inaccurate valuations directly affect financial results.

risks.title: Dependence on Transaction and Management Fees
risks.score_rationale: Transaction and administrative fees are a major revenue source detailed in the text. A decline in these activities or fee rates would reduce revenues.

risks.title: Impact of Compensation and Benefits Costs
risks.score_rationale: The text outlines the complex compensation structure, including variable and performance-based components as well as equity awards. Fluctuations in compensation costs can impact profitability.

risks.title: Fund Consolidation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The text explains consolidation rules and their impact on revenues and assets. Consolidation can increase gross assets and liabilities without a net impact on earnings, but changes may occur.

risks.title: Tax Risks and Tax Rate Exposure
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions the impact of federal, state, and foreign tax rates on net income. Regulatory tax changes represent an ongoing risk.
